bullets.text: Cloud-Based Ransomware Threat - **Storm-0501** shifts focus from on-premises to cloud tactics, exploiting hybrid environments.
Endpoint Security Leader - **Microsoft Defender** secures 28.6% market share, leading in modern endpoint security for third consecutive year.
Gears of War Reloaded - Available on **PC Game Pass**, marking a nostalgic return for fans of the franchise.
Securing Autonomous Agents - **Microsoft** emphasizes the need for governance as autonomous agents proliferate in enterprises.
Azure Infrastructure Security - **Microsoft** enhances security from silicon to systems, ensuring robust protection across Azure.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New features rolling out, including seamless app resumption from **Android** to **PC**.
My Apps Feature Launch - **Xbox Insiders** can now access games faster through the new 'My Apps' feature on Windows 11.
Open Source Evolution - **Microsoft** transitions from skepticism to a leading contributor in the open-source community.
Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader - **Microsoft** recognized as a leader in Cloud-Native Application Platforms for the second consecutive year.
ClickFix Social Engineering - **Microsoft Defender** highlights the rising threat of ClickFix campaigns targeting enterprises.
